messages.subject: Global Mining Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Bergounhon,

Lincoln Strategic's specialist executive-search work across mining and metals makes this a highly relevant introduction. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive communications.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where responsible mining, institutional trust, regulatory execution and operating strategy intersect. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate and rotational assignments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
